title: The second apartment, the water
logline: The smaller Seattle apartment's one window, close: the water, larger than the first apartment's slice, and a chair pulled to it. Nobody in the chair. 'A smaller place, near the water' — the page takes the sentence literally.

panels.composition: A single apartment window close, filled with gray water and a far shore, a wooden chair pulled up to it facing out, empty, a mug on the sill.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a single apartment window filled with gray water and a far shore, an empty wooden chair pulled up facing it and a mug on the sill, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Near the water. The chair empty.
